error_handling: Preserve raw partial output and start/end/local clock limitations
Do not reuse stale or unknown consent
future_physical_checks: Fresh dedicated directory under local volume; no UNC/device/ADS/dot paths
Owner SID and existing DACL checked; no automatic ACL edit or ownership takeover
Hold directory identity; detect volume/mapping/parent changes; fail closed on race/unknown
Exclusive new intent and files; never overwrite or cleanup failed partial evidence
Review disk space and least existing access; no automatic Administrator/UAC/SeCreatePagefilePrivilege
privacy: No passwords, tokens, TPM OwnerAuth, private keys, command history or environment dump
Raw host/SID/volume/registry values remain private in approved folder
Evidence review produces a separate manually approved redacted public report; no automatic upload of target raw data
Redacted copies carry separate hashes and never replace originals
rights: Read current identity, fixed local CIM properties and Registry64 query-value only. No remote session, method invocation, writes, privilege enablement or arbitrary shell.
